newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Frontier says oil show in Vietnam well.
newsitem.headline: Frontier says oil show in Vietnam well.

text.p: Frontier Petroleum NL said on Friday that an open hole drill stem test was being prepared over the 1220-1230 metre interval in the Song Thai Bin B10-1X well in Vietnam's onshore Hanoi Basin after it encountered oil shows.
The objective of the well is to test a Permo-Carboniferous age carbonate buried hill, it said.
The top of the carbonate objective was encountered at 1225 metres and 24 barrels of mud was lost to the formation, implying porosity and/or a fractured reservoir, it said.
Cuttings samples recovered from the 1225-1230 metre interval were limestone with 30 percent oil fluorescence and fast streaming oil cut in solvent, Frontier said.
The samples left a light brown residual oil ring after the solvent evaporated, it said.
Thai Binh B10-1X is l6 km north-north east of the recent gas discovery at the Song Tra Ly D14-1X well, it said.
Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd operates the project on behalf of Frontier (20 percent) and Anzoil NL (80 percent).
